array.string: pgrep -xq LeoBot && exit 0; [ -f "$HOME/.leoagent/leobot-user-quit" ] && exit 0; L="$HOME/Library/Logs/leobot-keepalive.log"; C=$(ls -t "$HOME/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 -i leobot); echo "$(date '+%F %T') LeoBot 不在运行,重新拉起;最近崩溃报告:${C:-无}" >> "$L"; [ -d /Applications/LeoBot.app ] && open -g -a /Applications/LeoBot.app
